title: Tiny, cute paintbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Paintbrush handle -->
  <rect x='44' y='58' width='12' height='32' rx='5' fill='#F4A949'/>
  <rect x='44' y='58' width='5' height='32' rx='3' fill='#FFD27A'/>
  <!-- Metal ferrule -->
  <rect x='42' y='50' width='16' height='12' rx='3' fill='#B8C4CE'/>
  <rect x='42' y='50' width='16' height='4' rx='2' fill='#DDE6ED'/>
  <rect x='52' y='53' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#8E9BA8'/>
  <!-- Bristles -->
  <path d='M43 50 Q43 35 50 24 Q57 35 57 50 Z' fill='#FFCF6E'/>
  <path d='M45 50 Q45 37 50 28 Q55 37 55 50 Z' fill='#FFE3A3'/>
  <!-- Paint blob on tip -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='24' r='5' fill='#FF5FA2'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='22.5' r='2' fill='#FF9EC7'/>
  <!-- Drip -->
  <path d='M53 29 Q55 34 53 37 Q51 34 53 29 Z' fill='#FF5FA2'/>

  <circle cx='48' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#5A3A10'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='70' r='1.8' fill='#5A3A10'/>
  <path d='M48 75 Q52 78 56 75' stroke='#5A3A10' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='73' r='2' fill='#FF8FB8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='73' r='2' fill='#FF8FB8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
